about.label: About
about.title: A web studio that binds your identity to your customers' experience.
about.text: Washeej is a digital studio that builds websites and platforms end to end, from the interface to the server. We learn your business first, design an experience that fits your audience, then build it with clean, fast code that is easy to grow. Arabic is never a translation for us; it is a native right-to-left version.

items.quote: "We needed a corporate site that looked serious in both Arabic and English, and that's exactly what we got. Revisions came back fast and every decision was explained clearly."

faq.label: FAQ
faq.title: Answers to the questions we hear most.

items.q: How much does it cost, and how long does it take?
items.a: Every project has its own scope, so we set price and timeline after a short call about your needs. Get in touch and you'll receive a clear quote.
No. Every site is designed and built for your brand and audience.
Yes, with native RTL Arabic; more languages can be added.
Yes, it's tested on mobile, tablet and desktop before handover.
Yes, from a dashboard made for your site.
Yes, we connect the gateway that fits your country, such as mada, Apple Pay, Tabby and Tamara in the Gulf, or Paymob and Fawry in Egypt.

items.q: Can you add AI to my site?
items.a: Yes, for example an assistant that understands requests in plain words or voice, or reads data from photos and invoices.

items.q: Is it ready for search engines?
items.a: It's built with search basics: speed, clean URLs, and a title and description for every page in both languages.
We help you choose them, then publish and connect the site.
Once paid in full, the site and its content are yours.
You review the design before development and get regular updates at every stage.

items.q: Do you work with clients in Saudi Arabia and the Gulf?
items.a: Yes. Saudi Arabia is our main market, and we work remotely with clients across the Gulf, Egypt and the Arab world.
Launch isn't the end. We stay with you, look after the site and help with any change or question.
